# lfreleng-actions

> The Linux Foundation Release Engineering GitHub organisation publishes
> reusable GitHub Actions and reusable workflows for building, testing,
> auditing and releasing projects. This `.github` repository holds the
> organisation-wide configuration and the catalogue of everything the
> organisation offers.

This file is an index, not a copy. The catalogue in `profile/README.md`
lists every action with a one-line description and stays current; the
links below point into it by category.

To find an action for a workflow:

1. Pick the category below that matches the job.
2. Open that catalogue section and choose an action from its table.
3. Follow the link to the action repository and read its README and
   `action.yaml` for inputs and outputs.
4. Where a reusable workflow repository covers the whole job, prefer
   calling it over assembling individual actions.
5. Consume actions as `lfreleng-actions/<name>@<commit-sha> # vX.Y.Z`.

## Catalogue

- [Organisation profile and catalogue](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md): Full categorised directory of actions, workflows, bots, tools and fixtures
- [Build & Test Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-build--test-actions): Build, test, audit and SBOM generation for Python, Java, Node.js, Go, Rust, Docker, Make and docs
- [Publishing & Release Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-publishing--release-actions): Publish to PyPI, Maven Central, Nexus, npm, crates.io and OCI registries; promote GitHub releases and images
- [Cloud & Infrastructure Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#%EF%B8%8F-cloud--infrastructure-actions): Packer builds, OpenStack bastions over Tailscale and cloud resource clean-up
- [Python Project Metadata Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-python-project-metadata-actions): Read and update Python project name, version, metadata and supported versions
- [Tag & Version Validation Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#%EF%B8%8F-tag--version-validation-actions): Validate SemVer/CalVer tags and signatures, verify tag pushes, extract and increment versions
- [Gerrit Integration Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-gerrit-integration-actions): Mirror pull requests to Gerrit, check out changes, vote and run test Gerrit servers
- [Security & Credentials Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-security--credentials-actions): Secrets retrieval, signing, vulnerability and workflow scanning, egress allow-lists
- [Repository & Code Quality Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-repository--code-quality-actions): Repository and build metadata, linting, pinning checks, change detection and config audits
- [Utility Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#%EF%B8%8F-utility-actions): General helpers for git, files, JSON, URLs, variables, releases and local test services

## Reusable workflows

- [Workflow Repositories](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-workflow-repositories): Reusable workflow repositories for Python, Go, Node.js, Java, Rust, Docker, generic release, security and docs
- [Building GitHub Workflows](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#building-github-workflows): Using the actions with GitHub alone or with Gerrit, plus example workflows

## Workflow conventions

- [GitHub Actions pinning](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/AGENTS.md#44-github-actions-pinning): Pin remote `uses:` to a full commit SHA; never floating tags or tag-object SHAs
- [Harden-runner egress allow-list](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/README.md#harden-runner-egress-allow-list): Run step-security/harden-runner with `egress-policy: block`, loading the organisation allow-list via harden-runner-block-action
- [Egress allow-list file](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/.github/harden-runner/lfreleng-actions/allow_list.txt): Hosts a job contacts must appear here or block mode denies the connection
- [Workflow security audits](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/AGENTS.md#45-workflow-security-audits): Audit workflow changes locally with zizmor, `auditor` persona, zero findings
- [Organisation-wide zizmor audit](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/README.md#organisation-wide-zizmor-audit): Organisation workflow auditing workflows with zizmor (`auditor` persona); advisory, findings land in code scanning
- [Organisation-wide aislop scan](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/README.md#organisation-wide-aislop-scan): Organisation workflow scanning the files a pull request changes; any finding fails the check, and blocks the merge where required
- [PR title must match the commit subject](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/AGENTS.md#101-pr-title-must-match-the-commit-subject): The mandatory Semantic Pull Request check; a single-commit PR title must equal its commit subject

## Bots

- [Bots](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-bots): Scheduled Copilot-driven bots for issue triage, issue fixes and pull request review

## Tools

- [Tools](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-tools): Command-line tools and libraries for release engineering work
- [Reporting Tools](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-reporting-tools): Multi-repository reporting, security reporting and egress allow-list generation

## Optional

- [Test Fixtures & Sample Projects](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-test-fixtures--sample-projects): Sample projects and fixtures that exercise the actions and workflows
- [Organisation Resources](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#-organisation-resources): Templates for new actions, workflow repositories and bots
- [Organisation-wide configuration](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/README.md): Shared configuration and the organisation-wide workflows in this repository
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Binding contribution rules for AI coding agents in every organisation repository
- [Tagging and Releasing Actions](https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md#tagging-and-releasing-actions): How to tag and release an action repository
